facts.fact: Levellers says that as of June 2026 Cameroon has no AI-specific statute, no bill creating an AI regulator and no enacted text for the AI framework law the national strategy proposes.

The Minister of Posts and Telecommunications unveiled the National AI Strategy (SNIA) on 7 July 2025 at CONIA; Levellers cites OECD.AI listing its status as proposed or under development and says its proposed AI authority and council are not established.

CMR.note: No locally built AI model, dataset or compute stated.
